A box for a PA-130B adapter is visible in photo 0.

risks.if_unproven: as an empty box or incorrect item

risks.risk: The keyboard may have physical damage or non-functional keys/electronics.
risks.proof: A video of the keyboard powered on with all keys being played and the screen functioning.

risks.risk: The power adapter may be missing or faulty.
risks.proof: A photo of the adapter and a video of it powering the keyboard.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual keyboard out of the box.
Video of the keyboard powered on and being played to test all keys.
Photo of the power adapter out of its box.
response.reason: The model is clearly identified from the retail packaging, which allows for a valuation. However, because the actual item is not shown, it must be priced at its worst-case scenario (non-functional/parts only) until its existence and condition are verified.
